Commentary.Commentary: We are back for England's reply! The players are out in the middle. Tammy Beaumont and Emma Lamb will open the batting for England Women. Jhulan Goswami will begin proceedings with the ball. Let's go!
... The Run Chase ...

Right then! England Women have a huge score and they need someone like Harmanpreet Kaur to anchor the innings. They have to chase this massive total to keep the series alive. Stay tuned for the chase.

England Women chose to bowl first but things didn't go well. They were very loose with the ball throughout the innings. Gave too many extras and never created any pressure. They even missed a sixth bowler who could have given some chance and an extra option. They started off on the wrong foot, but controlled things well in the middle phase. But if there is one thing they would be disappointed about is leaking 121 runs in the final 10 overs. All their bowlers went for aplenty. They face a tough challenge now.

This was a well-paced innings from India Women! They got off to a superb start thanks to the stand between Smriti Mandhana and Yastika Bhatia. Once they fell, Harleen Deol and Harmanpreet Kaur combined to put in another huge partnership of 113 runs. Things went slow at first but both paced their innings really well. Deol fell after her fifty but it was then Harmanpreet Kaur who took the baton in her hand. She scored a wonderful century and helped India get over the 300-mark. That final flourish from her has given an extra boost to the team.

End of a sensational batting performance from India Women. They have played just the way they wanted and have given themselves a huge chance to win the series. The credit goes to their skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur who played one of her best innings. There is no doubt that India Women will be the happier side going into this break.
A dot to finish the innings. Outside off, a length ball. Harmanpreet Kaur misses her cut this time. India Women finish at 333 for 5!
FOUR! Poor ball and punished! Slow, short and wide of off. Harmanpreet Kaur cuts it hard and past point for another four.
FOUR! It's raining boundaries at the moment. Another full, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur hoicks this one wide of long on for a boundary.
FOUR! Crunched! A six followed by a four. A fuller ball, around middle and off. Harmanpreet Kaur once again backs away and thumps it through cover for a cracking boundary.
SIX! WHAT A SHOT! Unbelievable batting from Kaur. A fuller ball, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur makes room and slices this one high over point for a maximum.
Freya Kemp begins the final over with a full ball, around the leg pole. Deepti Sharma sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Pitches it up, around middle and leg. Deepti Sharma works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single. 17 runs off that over.
Very full, tossed up, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur knocks it towards long on for a single.

FOUR MORE! Runs are flowing for India Women! That brings up the 50-run stand between these two in just 22 balls. A fuller one, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur lofts this one over cover for another boundary.
SIX! Up and away! This is Harmanpreet Kaur at her absolute best. Tossed-up delivery, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur gets down on her knee and smashes this over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Full, on the pads. Harmanpreet Kaur uses her wrists and flicks it towards deep square leg for a boundary. That brings up the 300 for India Women!
A loopy ball, full, down leg. Deepti Sharma gets down on her knee and sweeps it towards fine leg for a single.
Slower now, short and outside off. Deepti Sharma knocks it towards cover for a single.
FOUR! Deepti Sharma gets into the act as well. A fuller ball, around middle. Deepti Sharma heaves this one across the line past mid-wicket for a boundary. 25 of the over with one ball to go.
2 Wides! This is poor bowling from the debutant. Another one down leg. Harmanpreet Kaur leaves it alone. Amy Jones fumbles to stop the ball as well. The batters take another run.
FOUR! Slapped away! Width on offer, slightly short in length, Harmanpreet Kaur makes room and slashes it past point for a boundary.
Wide! Make that four wide in the over! Once again down leg. Harmanpreet Kaur lets that go through. Wide called.
Wide! Down the leg side, fuller ball. Left alone. Wide called. Three wides in the over.
SIX! Oh, shot! A mighty blow from Kaur. A length ball, around middle and off. Harmanpreet Kaur makes room and lifts it nonchalantly over extra cover for a biggie.
Angling in, a length ball, around middle. Deepti Sharma works it away through mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! Another one! Down the leg side, Deepti Sharma once again fails to get her on it while trying to sweep this one. Wided.
Wide! Down the leg side now, another fuller ball. Deepti Sharma looks to sweep this one but she misses. Wide called.
FOUR! A boundary to begin with! A fuller ball from 'round the wicket, around the leg pole. Deepti Sharma whips it towards fine leg for a boundary.
Shorter ball, around middle and leg. Deepti Sharma flicks it towards square leg for a single. She retains the strike.

There it is! A fuller ball, around middle and off. Harmanpreet Kaur knocks it down to long off and takes a single. A century for the Indian skipper! What a knock this has been. Her fifth ODI hundred and her second against England. She removes her helmet, raises her bat and soaks in all the applause.
FOUR! Top shot! A loopy ball, full, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur gets down on her knee and sweeps it powerfully towards deep square leg for a boundary. 99 now!
Wide! Spills this one down the leg side, a shorter ball. Harmanpreet Kaur misses her flick. Wide called.
Very full, outside off, tossed up as well. Harmanpreet Kaur drives it to the fielder at cover.
Around middle and off, loopy ball, around middle. Deepti Sharma nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
A fuller ball, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps this one towards deep square leg for a single.
Deepti Sharma comes in.

OUT! TAKEN! A wicket on debut! A deserving one too. Pooja Vastrakar departs now and India Women have lost half their side. A short ball, around off. Pooja Vastrakar makes room and looks to slash this one over cover. But she miscues her shot and ends up chipping it to the fielder there. Emma Lamb takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Emma Lamb b Freya Kemp

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Crunched! Second boundary of the over. A fuller one, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar thumps this one past mid off for a boundary.
A good-length delivery, outisde off. Harmanpreet Kaur guides it towards point. The fielder there dives to her left and makes a good stop. Only a single.
Tad slower, fullish ball, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur chips it aerially away fron the fielder at mid off.
Angling in, a length ball, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur looks to pull this one but she misses. The ball gets stuck between her pads.
FOUR! Oh, lovely shot! A length ball, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur waits for it, opens the face of her bat and guides it through point for a boundary. She moves on to 93 with that!
Freya Kemp comes back to bowl. 28 runs in her 7 overs so far.
Too full and on middle. Vastrakar steers it to backward point.
On a length and outside off, swept to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR MORE! Excellent stuff from the skipper! She is all set for a hundred now! A juicy half volley, outside off. Kaur crunches it through covers for four more. 250 up!
Too full and outside off. Kaur jams it to cover.

FOUR! Cheeky! On a length and outside off. Kaur tries to paddle scoop it. She wanted to play to third man but miscues it to fine leg. The fielde runs across but only to parry it on the ropes for four.
On middle, it is driven to mid on for a single.
On a length and outside off. Kaur plays it to cover.
Slower ball, outside off. Vastrakar drills it to long on for a single.
Around off, pushed to covers.
Fuller ball on off. Kaur lofts it to long on for a single.
This is fuller ball, outside off, might be slower one. Kaur looks to push but misses.
A single as this it hit to mid on.
FOUR! A couple of boundaries in this over as well! Short of a length and outside off. Kaur heaves it across to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Too full and on off, kept out. Well bowled.
FOUR MORE! Boundaries coming easily for India now! This is easy for Kaur!  Full delivery, outside off and Kaur powers it over the bowler for a boundary.
Outside off. Kaur punches it well but finds point.
This one skids through, outside off. Vastrakar leans to push but gets an inside edge to square leg. One.
On middle, this is hit to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Second off the over! 12 runs overall! India moving along nicely! 280 looks possible! On a length and outside off. Vastrakar plays it very late to third man for a boundary.
Bell serves it outside off. Vastrakar pushes it to covers.
Length ball, outside off. Kaur steps across and knocks it to deep cover for one.
Shorter and outside off, pulled hard to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! This is on a length and way outside off. Kaur gets on the back foot, picks the length early and pulls it to mid-wicket for four.
A length ball, outside off. Vastrakar carves it through point for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Kaur punches it sweetly but finds cover-point.
Wide! Length ball, way down the leg side, swings a bit more. Wided.
Outside off, Vastrakar works it through point for one.
FOUR! Uppish but safe for four! On a driving length, outside off. Vastrakar drives on the up to covers. The fielder there dives to her right and gets fingertips on it. It races away to the fence.
On a length and outside off, skids on. Vastrakar has a poke at it but misses. Three dots, pressure on Vastrakar.
Length ball, outside off. Vastrakar drops it to cover.
Fuller and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Time for Powerplay 3! Now, England Women are allowed to place 5 fielders outside the inner circle. Also, Pooja Vastrakar makes her way out in middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Finally, the 113-run stand is broken! What a partnership this was! On a length and around off. Deol swings across but was a touch early to her shot. Danni Wyatt at deep mid-wicket takes a clean catch. England Women would look to build on this now.
Commentary.Howout: c Danni Wyatt b Lauren Bell

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, outside off, guided to deep point for a single.
Wide! This is down the leg side. Kaur leaves it.
FOUR! 11 already off the over! Overpitched, around off. Kaur drives it on the front foot through covers and beats the fielder in the deep as well.
On the hips, nudged to deep square leg for one.
Outside off, punched to cover.
SIX! WHAT A SHOT! Bell fires a length ball, outside off. Deol drags a bit but it came right off the middle and the ball sails over mid-wicket for a six.
Lauren Bell (7-0-51-0) comes back to bowl. She replaces Sophie Ecclestone.
Length and outside off, dabbed to backward point.
Full and on off. Kept out.
TWO MORE! Length ball, outside off. Kaur opens the face of the bat and dabs it to third man. Freya Kemp does well to save a couple.
Full ball on middle. Kaur lofts it not off the middle of the bat but does well to clear the infield. Two runs added.
This is on a length and outside off. Kaur tries to play the pre-meditated paddle scoop on the off side but misses.
Touch fuller and outside off. Deol drives it to sweeper cover for one.
Kate Cross is brought back into the attack. 1 for 37 in her 6 overs thus far.
Flatter ball on middle. Deol flicks it past mid-wicket for a single. Fifty now for Harleen Deol, a really good innings so far from her.
Flighted ball on middle. Blocked out.
Tossed up on middle. Kaur sweeps it to mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, guided to point.
Fuller ball, slanting on middle, Kaur pushes it to the bowler.
Angles a full ball on middle. Kaur helps it away to short fine leg.
Tossed up, outside off. Deol comes down the track and taps it back to the bowler.
Kaur again tries to hit this away but drags it to long on for one.

SIX! The skipper reaches her fifty with a wonderful shot! A measured innings till now but needs to continue! Looped up, outside off. Kaur shuffles across and slog-sweeps it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Fuller ball on middle. Deol skips down and bunts it to long on for a single.
On middle. Blocked out.
Flatter and on middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
Full and outside off. Kaur plays it to cover.
Outside off, eased to long off for one.
SIX! UP AND AWAY! Beautiful shot! This is full and on middle. Deol comes down the track and reaches to the pitch of the ball and launches it over long on for a biggie.
Tossed up on middle. Deol again pushes it straight to mid on.
On middle, Deol works it to mid on.
This is full and on middle. Kaur eases it to mid off for a quick single.
Full again, outside off. Deol fends it away to mid on.
Fuller ball, outside off. Deol pushes it back to the bowler.
On middle, nudged to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Much needed! Even one each over can help India put a par score. They need to keep the momentum with still 7 wickets in hand! This is full and outside off. Deol smashes it over mid off for a boundary.
A juicy full toss on middle. Kaur pushes it to long on for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Deol squeezes it to covers for a run.
This is around off. Deol makes room and punches off the back foot through covers. A run.
Make it three in a row! Outside off on a length and Deol punches it to cover.
Another dot! Tossed up on middle. Deol comes down the track and nudges it to mid-wicket.
An arm ball, outside off. Deol defends with a straight bat.
Fuller, slower and outside off. Kaur drops it to point and runs across for a quick single.
Tossed up, outside off. Kaur blocks it out.
Around off, knocked to mid off.
Good hit but just a single! Tossed up, outside off. Kaur stays back and slogs it to deep mid-wicket. Just wide of the fielder for a single.
Flatter, slower and on middle. Kaur rocks back and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Two runs now! Pitched up, outside off. Kaur drives it to deep cover for a couple of runs. Good running.
Another dot! On middle, this is hit to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on middle. Kaur pushes it to mid on.
Charlotte Dean is back into the attack. 1 for 22 in her 7 overs so far.
Slower ball and again this one stays low. Kaur picks it up and hits it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length and outside off. Deol cuts it to deep backward point for a single.
Wide! Short in length but way down the leg side. Deol misses her pull.
TWO RUNS! On the pads, this is flicked past mid-wicket for easy couple.
This is full and outside off. Kaur drives on the up and to covers for a single.
On the pads, pushed to mid-wicket.
Fuller ball, outside off. Kaur knocks it to cover.
A single to end the over as Kaur hits it through covers.
Fuller and way outside off, driven to deep cover for a single.
Fuller and on middle, drilled to long on for a single.
Outside off, pushed to cover.
FOUR! Kaur gets into the act now. This is short and around off, it stays very low. Kaur does well to adjust as she pulls it behind square on the leg side for four.
On a length and outside off, Deol pushes it through covers for one.
Around middle and off, a length ball. Harmanpreet Kaur blocks it from within her crease.
Tad fuller, outside off again. Harmanpreet Kaur opens the face of her bat and pushes it towards cover-point.
On a length, outside off. Harleen Deol cuts it through point for a single.
Slightly short in length, outside off. Harleen Deol knocks it off the back foot towards point.
Another length delivery, outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur punches it off the back foot towards cover for a single.
Outside off, a length ball. Harmanpreet Kaur miscues her cut shot towards point.
FOUR! Up and over! Angling in, around middle, on a length. Harleen Deol heaves this one across the line and over square leg for a boundary.
Quick single! Another good-length delivery, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur knocks it towards cover and runs across to the other end.
Wide! Down the leg side, a length ball. Harmanpreet Kaur misses her flick. Wide given.

Drinks! Alice Capsey hurts her finger and needs some treatment. The players take the time to hydrate themselves. India might have lost just three wickets but England have done well so far to keep things under control. Runs aren't coming easy for the visitors but will look to change the gears now. Alice Capsey meanwhile walks off the field for more attention.

A fuller ball, around off. Harleen Deol shuffles across and flicks it towards mid-wicket. Alice Capsey dives ot stop the ball, but she fails to do so. A single taken. She seems to have hurt her finger while trying to stop the ball. The physio is out there.
Slightly shorter this time, outside off. Harleen Deol looks to cut this one away but the ball goes off her under edge towards point.
Outside off, on a length. Harmanpreet Kaur opens the face of her bat and guides it towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done! A fullish ball, around middle and leg. Harmanpreet Kaur flicks this one uppishly over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Wide! Wide of off, a length ball. Harmanpreet Kaur looks to slash this one but she fails to reach the ball. Wide given.
FOUR! This will take some pressure off the batters! A length ball, width on offer. Harleen Deol cuts it last, past point for a boundary.
A fuller ball, around middle. Harleen Deol takes the aerial route this time. She lofts this one over mid on for a brace.
Outside off, length ball. Harleen Deol gets on top of that one and dabs it towards cover.
Angling in now, another good-length delivery, around middle. Harleen Deol knocks it towards mid-wicket.
A length ball, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur pushes it off the back foot towards cover for a single.
Wide! Kate Cross spills this one down the leg side. Harmanpreet Kaur misses her flick. Wide called.
Halt in play! Harmanpreet Kaur gets hit near the thigh region and needs some treatment. The physio is out.

This one tails back in off a length, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur looks to pull this one but she misses. The ball goes on and hits her on the thigh pad. A huge shout for LBW, but the umpire disagrees.
Play and a miss! On a length, angling in, around the fifth stump line. Harleen Deol rocks back and looks to pull this one, but she fails to get any bat on it.
Two now! A length ball, outside the off pole. Harleen Deol rocks back and punches it through backward point for a brace.
Make that four dots. A fuller ball, outside off. Harleen Deol pushes it off the front foot towards mid off.
Pitches it up this time, outside off. Harleen Deol leans and drives it square of the wicket on the off side. Not in the gap through. Three dots on the trot now.
This one angles in, another length ball, around middle. Harleen Deol works it away towards the fielder at mid on.
Swing and a miss! Outside off, a good-length delivery. Harleen Deol stays in her crease misses her cut.
A touch slow, on a length, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur steers it towards point off the back foot.

Well bowled! A wobble seam delivery, on a length, outside off. Harleen Deol looks to have a poke at this one, but she manages to get an outside edge away from the keeper towards third man. Another run is taken.
Width on offer, tad full on this occasion. Harmanpreet Kaur prods forward to drive but the ball goes off the outside edge toward third man. A single!
Pulls her length back now, serves it outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur stands tall and knocks it toward point. No run there!
Angling in now, full in length, around her toes. Harleen Deol works it away through square leg and rotates the strike.
Pitches this one up, serves it outside off. Harleen Deol leans in and drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Wide! Kate Cross begins her second spell with a length ball, down the leg side. Harleen Deol misses her flick. Wided.
Slower through the air, nicely flighted, outside off, very full. Harleen Deol lunges forward and pushes it through cover for a single. She retains the strike.
Outside off, short in length this time. Harleen Deol steers it towards point with an opened face bat.
Pitches this on up, fuller ball, around off. Harleen Deol drives and finds mid off.
Shorter ball, darting it on the pads. Harmanpreet Kaur flicks it towards square leg and runs across to the other end.
Another full ball, slower through the air, outside off, Harleen Deol works it away towards cover-point and takes a single.
Loopy ball, outside off. Harleen Deol leans in and drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Tossed up, pitched up as well, on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur defends this one out.
Back of a length, quicker, outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur blocks it out.
Outside off, full in length, outside off. Harleen Deol knocks it towards cover and roates the strike.
Flighted delivery, full, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur pushes it off the front foot towards cover for a single.
A shortish ball, down the leg side. Harmanpreet Kaur misses her flick.
Loopy ball, pitches it up, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur leans in and drives it towards cover.
Full, quick again, outside off. Harleen Deol taps it to point.
Outside off, tad quicker now, short in length. Harleen Deol looks to cut this one away but she misses.
Tad shorter now, outside off. Harleen Deol opens the face of her bat and dabs it towards point. No run there!
Tosses it up, full, outside off. Harleen Deol prods forward and plays it towards cover. No run there!
Flighted on middle, Harleen Deol pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Floats this one up, full, around off, Harmanpreet Kaur leans in and drives it through cover for a single.
Similar delivery! Flighted, full, around middle and leg. Harleen Deol taps it towards mid-wicket.
Another tossed-up delivery, around middle. Harleen Deol blocks it towards mid-wicket.
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Harleen Deol works it away towards mid-wicket.

A loopy delivery, down leg, full in length. Harleen Deol gets down on her knee and sweeps it towards fine leg for a brace. The umpires want to check for a run out here. There is a throw to the keeper, but Amy Jones collects the back and knocks the bails off with her leg. Not out it is!
Fires this one the pads, a shortish ball. Harmanpreet Kaur dabs it towards square leg and takes a quick single.
Wide! Sophie Ecclestone errs in line as she spills this one down the leg side. Wide given.
FOUR! Nicely done! Back of a length, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur stays in her crease, opens the face of her bat, and guides it past for a lovely boundary.
Slower through the air, flighted delivery, outside off, full in length. Harleen Deol pushes it towards point. A dot to end the over.
FOUR! Cut away! Her second boundary already. Short and width on offer this time, Harleen Deol rocks and slashes it past point for a boundary.
Outside the off pole, touch short on this occasion. Harleen Deol blocks it towards cover.
Tosses this one up, full, around middle. Harleen Deol clips it towards mid-wicket.
Swing and a miss! Short and wide of off. Harleen Deol looks to cut this one but she fails to get any bat on it.
A loopy ball from over the wicket, around middle and leg. Harleen Deol flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Outside off, this is guided straight to backward point.
On middle, this is hit past mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! This is too short and way outside off. Deol cuts it to point where the fielder fails to stop despite the dive. Four more and 100 is up for India.
Fuller ball, outside off. Deol taps it to cover.
Tossed up, around off. Deol prods and defends it out.
Harleen Deol is the new batter in.

OUT! LBW! Sophie Ecclestone gets the big wicket. Tossed up, around off and spins back in. Mandhana gets on her knee as she looks to slog-sweep but misses and gets hit on the back pad. An appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. Ultra Edge shows no bat. The Ball Tracking shows impact is the umpire's call. The decision stays and Mandhana has to walk back. A well-made 40 from her.
Fuller ball, outside off. Kaur skips down and works it back to Dean.
Too full and on off. Kaur drives it to the left of Dean who does well to dive and stop.
Slower through the air, full and outside off. Kaur leans and tries to defend but does so inside the line.
Tossed up on middle, skids on. Mandhana bunts it to square leg for a single.
Around off, pushed to covers.
Dean sees Mandhana come down the track and fires a full toss, this is pushed to mid on.
Charlotte Dean is back on! 13 runs and a wicket in her 3 overs so far.
Quicker, flatter and on middle. Kaur stays back and blocks it out.
On middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Overthrow! Full and on off. Kaur pushes it to mid off and calls for a single. The fielder there has a shy at the keeper's end but misses and the batters rotate the strike as no one was backing up.
Around off, drilled to long on for a single.
Outside off, punched to covers.
This one skids through, outside off. Mandhana keeps it out.
FOUR! The skipper looks in good touch here! A good pitch to bat overall as the ball is coming nicely onto the bat. Kemp drops it short and Kaur is quick to pull it away to square leg for a boundary.
Length ball, around leg. Kaur defends it back to Kemp.
A bit of width here, outside off, Mandhana slaps it to deep point for one.
A loopy ball, around off, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
This is full and around off. Mandhana pushes it to covers. The fielder there misfield and parries it to mid off. The batters cross.
On middle, kept out.
An arm ball, this is full and on off. Kaur again blocks it.
Slower through the air on middle. Kaur leans and blocks.
Touch short and outside off. Mandhana cuts it to deep point for a run.
On middle. Defended out.
SIX! BANG! Excellent shot! Tossed up on middle. Mandhana comes down the track and heaves it across over mid-wicket for a biggie. She made it look so easy.
Tossed up, outside off. Kaur drops it to covers for a single.
Sophie Ecclestone comes on to bowl. She replaces Charlotte Dean.
Length ball, around off and nips a bit away. Mandhana splices it to point.
Driven nicely but straight to the fielder! This is full and on off, it is hit to covers.
Length and on middle. Mandhana flicks it to mid-wicket.
This is full and outside off. Kaur drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Length and on middle. Blocked out.
On the pads, this is flicked wide of mid-wicket for a single.

DRINKS! India Women might have their noses slightly ahead so far. They might have lost two wickets, but runs are coming by easily. Smriti Mandhana is well-set now, she will look to go big along with Harmanpreet Kaur at the other end. This is the partnership England Women will have to try and break.
This is around off. Kaur dabs it to backward point where Alice Capsey half-stops it. Two runs taken.
Floated, full and outside off. Mandhana hits it through covers for one more.
Flatter ball, around off. Mandhana knocks it to mid off.
Tossed up on middle, angling down, tickled to short fine leg for a single.
Fuller ball on off. Kaur flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
Wide! Another wide as Dean delivers it down the leg side.
Two wides! Dean slides one down the leg side. Mandhana misses her whip and it goes to fine leg for a single.
Tossed up, around off. Mandhana stays back and punches it to mid off.
On a length and around off. Kaur defends it out.
Around off, pushed to covers.
Just chipped over! This is on a length and on middle. Kaur hits it over mid on, not timed well and they get a couple.
Length and on middle. Kaur lunges and blocks it out solidly.
Another single as Mandhana hits it through covers.
Angles across a full ball, outside off. Kaur splices it to third man for a single.
On middle. Kaur tucks it to square leg to get off the mark with a single.
Very full and on middle, played back to the bowler.
The skipper of India Women, Harmanpreet Kaur comes to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Dean breaks the stand! She tosses it up, full and on middle. Bhatia tries to get under the ball but fails and hits it firmly straight back to Charlotte Dean who gets low and holds onto it. Yastika Bhatia's promising innings come to its conclusion.
An arm ball on middle. Bhatia keeps it out.
Dean serves it flat and outside off. Mandhana punches it through covers for one.
Too full, flighted on middle. Mandhana works it to mid off.
Around off, nudged to mid-wicket.
Fuller ball, on off, pushed to mid off.
FOUR! Lovely shot! On a length and outside off. Bhatia guides it through point, beats the fielder and it races into the fence. The stand between these two reaches the 50-mark.
Goes fuller now and makes it to nip back in, around middle. Bhatia nudges it to mid on.
Length ball on top of off. Bhatia blocks it out to mid off.
Length and outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Powerplay 2! Now, four fielders are allowed outside the circle till the 40th over.

Tosses this one up, fuller one, slower through the air, around middle and off. Yastika Bhatia looks to drive this but the ball goes back to the bowler off her inner half of the bat. A dot end the last ball of the Powerplay. India Women are 60 for 1 at the end of the first Powerplay.
Spinning away, a shorter ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana punches it gently off the back foot towards extra cover. One run.
A fuller one, spinning away, outside off. Yastika Bhatia prods forward and taps it towards point for a single.
Back of a length again, outside off. Smriti Mandhana presses this one off the back foot towards cover for a single.
Pulls her length back now, a short one, around middle. Smriti Mandhana pushes it off the back foot towards mid on.
Charlotte Dean comes in from 'round the wicket, she serves a loopy ball, around middle and leg, fuller one. Yastika Bhatia leans in and works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Charlotte Dean to bowl now.
A tidy start from Freya Kemp on her ODI debut! Only two runs off it. A length ball, around off. Smriti Mandhana punches it towards mid off.
Outside off, a good-length delivery. Yastika Bhatia rocks back and cuts it through point for a single.
Swinging in, around middle, a length ball. Yastika Bhatia pushes it towards mid on. Three dots in a row now.
Pitches it up this time, around off. A solid front-foot defense from Yastika Bhatia.
Around off, on a length. Yastika Bhatia blocks it out.
Freya Kemp sprints in from 'round the wicket, serves a length ball, angling in, around middle and leg. Smriti Mandhana clips it towards deep square leg for a single.
Change. Freya Kemp is into the attack.
Fuller ball now, around middle and off. Yastika Bhatia lunges forward and blocks it towards mid off.
Around middle, on a length. Yastika Bhatia blocks it out.
Another length ball, around middle and leg. Smriti Mandhana works it away through square leg for a single.

FOUR! Easy pickings! A length ball, darting down leg. Smriti Mandhana flicks it towards fine leg for a boudnary. That brings up the 50 for India Women! With that, Smriti Mandhana also goes past 3000 runs in ODI cricket.
A good-length delivery, outside off. Smriti Mandhana looks to cut this one again, but she gets an under edge back onto the deck.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for India Women! A length ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana stays in her crease and slashes that one through point for another boundary.

FOUR! Another brave shot from Yastika Bhatia! A boundary to nd the 7th over as well. A fuller ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia shimmies down the pitch and drives it through cover-point for a boundary.
A length ball, swinging away, around middle. Yastika Bhatia taps it towards mid-wicket.
Beaten now! A good-length delivery, outside off. Yastika Bhatia gets beaten on the outside edge while trying to block this one.
Fuller ball, around off. Smriti Mandhana once again pushes it down the ground. The fielder from mid off will cut it out this time. Only a single.
Outside off, a length ball. Smriti Mandhana pushes it towards cover.
FOUR! Another glorious straight drive from Smriti Mandhana! Fuller ball, around off. Smriti Mandhana gets to the pitch of that one and drives it down the ground for a boundary.

FOUR! A boundary to end the 6th over. Good shot from Yastika Bhatia! Kate Cross serves it full, outside off. Yastika Bhatia dances down the pitch and drives it powerfully through cover for a boundary.
Pitches it up now, around off. Yastika Bhatia pushes it towards mid off. A dot ball.
Wide! Down leg now, another short ball. Yastika Bhatia ducks under it and lets that go through. Wided.
Kate Cross drops it short now, around middle and off. Yastika Bhatia sways away from that one.
Fuller ball, around middle and off. Smriti Mandhana chips it uppishly away from mid off. Tammy Beaumont runs to her left from mid off, dives, and makes a good stop. Single taken.
Pulls her length back a tad, around middle. Smriti Mandhana blocks it out from within her crease.
Pitched-up delivery, outside off. Smriti Mandhana miscues her drive toward the fielder at mid off.
Angling in, a length ball, around middle and leg. Yastika Bhatia misses her tuck and gets a hit on her pads. A stifled appeal there for LBW, but the umpire says no.
A good-length delivery, outside off. Yastika Bhatia opens the face of her bat and steers it towards backward point.
Wide of off, full in length again. Yastika Bhatia leaves it alone.
Fuller, outside off. Yastika Bhatia leans and blocks it out solidly.
Wide! Lauren Bell spills it down the leg side, slower one, a length ball. Yastika Bhatia looks to flick this one but she misses. Wided.
Leg bye! Tad fuller, darting it on the pads. Smriti Mandhana looks to flick but she misses and gets hit on her pads. The ball rolls away towards square leg and the batters cross ends.
Quick single! A length ball, angling in, around her pads. Yastika Bhatia tucks it towards mid-wicket and scmpaers across to the other end. Sophia Dunkley has a shy at the bowler's end but she misses.
Fuller one, outside off. Yastika Bhatia leans to block this, but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a single. She retains the strike.
Around middle and leg, a length ball. Smriti Mandhana works it away through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Oh, shot! Fuller in length, around middle. Smriti Mandhana presents the full face of the bat and drives it straight down the ground for a gorgeous boundary. Perfect timing on that one.
Outside off this time, a length delivery. Yastika Bhatia rocks back and punches it through cover-point. Three taken.
On a length again, around middle and off. Yastika Bhatia keeps this one out.
Kate Cross speeds in from over the wicket, she serves a length ball, around middle. Yastika Bhatia blocks it from within her crease.
Wide of off, pitches it up. Smriti Mandhana leaves it alone.
Much fuller now, around off. Smriti Mandhana manages to get an inside edge onto her pads while trying to drive this one.

Another good-length delivery, around middle and leg. Smriti Mandhana looks to pull this one but she misses and gets hit on her pads. A huge shout for LBW, but the umpire says no. That was pitching outside leg.
On a length, outside off this time. Smriti Mandhana drives this one on the up but finds the fielder at mid off.
Darting this one on the pads, a length ball. Yastika Bhatia tucks it towards square leg and takes a single.
FOUR! Glorious! An overpitched delivery, outside off. Yastika Bhatia leans in and creams her drive square of the wicket on the off side for a boundary.
Uppish and falls short once again! Full again, on the pads now. Smriti Mandhana chips this one aerially and the ball lands just away from short mid-wicket.
Edged and just short! A fuller ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana looks to drive this but the ball goes off the outside edge and lands just short of the fielder at second slip.
A length ball, outside off, Yastika Bhatia dabs it towards backward point and takes a single. She is off the mark!
Yastika Bhatia walks out.

OUT! CLEANED UP! Lovely bowling from Kate Cross! She draws first blood and gets rid of the dangerous, Shafali Verma on her third delivery. A length ball, nipping back in a tad, touch slow as well, around middle. Shafali Verma tries to push this on the off side but she misses. The ball goes past her inside edge and knocks the bails off. Great start for Kate Cross on her 50th ODI!
Well bowled! A yorker-length delivery, around middle. Shafali Verma digs this one out.
Kate Cross begins with a length ball, outside off, Shafali Verma opens the face of her bat and dabs it towards point.
Kate Cross to bowl now.
Outside off, a good-length delivery. Smriti Mandhana hangs back and pushes it towards cover. 12 runs off the first over.
Angling in, on a length, around middle. Smriti Mandhana taps it towards mid-wicket.
Two wides! Lauren Bell sprays it down leg once again, Amy Jones fails to collect the ball cleanly and the batters cross ends as well.

FOUR! Streaky boundary! Fuller one now, outside off. Shafali Verma looks to drive this one but the ball goes off the outside edge away from the fielder at slip towards third man for another boundary. India Women are off to a flier!
FOUR! Shafali Verma is off the mark in style! Width on offer now, outside off. Shafali Verma takes a step forward and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Wide! Lauren Bell spills this one down the leg side now, slower one, full as well. Shafali Verma lets that go through. Another wide.
Wide! Full again, wide of off, no movement there. Shafali Verma leaves it alone. Wide given. India Women are underway with that.
Touch fuller, angling in again, outside off. Shafali Verma prods forward and blocks it towards point.
Lauren Bell begins with a length ball, tailing back in, outside off. Shafali Verma rocks back and pushes it towards cover-point.
We are all set for the action. The players are out in the middle. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma are the openers for India. Lauren Bell to start with the ball.

India Women (Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Harleen Deol, Yastika Bhatia (WK), Deepti Sharma, Pooja Vastrakar, Jhulan Goswami, Dayalan Hemalatha (In for Sneh Rana), Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Renuka Singh (In for Meghna Singh).

England Women (Playing XI) - Tammy Beaumont, Emma Lamb, Sophia Dunkley, Alice Capsey, Danni Wyatt, Amy Jones (C/WK), Freya Kemp (In for Alice Davidson-Richards), Sophie Ecclestone, Charlotte Dean, Kate Cross, Lauren Bell (In for Issy Wong).
TOSS - England Women have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first!

After a woeful 2-1 series defeat, the Women in Blue raised their standards and got over the line in the first ODI. They will be coming into this game high on confidence and will look to secure the series for the first time since 1999. England Women on the flip side will be looking to get back at their best and make things all square. They will be hoping their top order scores some runs this time around. The hosts might not have many experienced players, but they have enough quality in their ranks to get back to winning ways. Stick around for the toss and other updates.
